2707-4872-8267.easyPrerequisites: Cybernetic Specialist doesn't have summoning sickness.
2707-4872-8267.description:
Cast Time Warp by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Activate Cybernetic Specialist by paying {1} and tapping it, causing you to put Time Warp on the bottom of your library from your graveyard.
Move to your next turn, drawing Time Warp from the bottom of your library due to River Song during your draw step.
Repeat.

719-6798-6871-6879.notablePrerequisites: You have an artifact creature in hand with the mana to cast it.
719-6798-6871-6879.description:
Cast any artifact creature by paying its mana cost.
When the artifact creature enters as an Ally due to Xenograft, Haru triggers, earthbending the artifact creature, as it's a land due to Toph.
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing the artifact creature.
When the creature dies, Haru triggers, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When the creature enters as an Ally due to Xenograft, Haru triggers, earthbending the creature, as it's a land due to Toph.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability, causing you to surveil 1.
Repeat from step 3.

2034-5003-8180.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Sphinx of False Conclusions, adding {C}{C}.
When Sphinx of False Conclusions dies, it and Nim Deathmantle trigger,
Resolve the Sphinx of False Conclusions trigger, creating a creature token.
Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing a creature token, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Nim Deathmantle trigger, causing you to pay {4} to return Sphinx of False Conclusions from your graveyard to the battlefield and attach Nim Deathmantle to it.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

6798-6972-8174.description:
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Mabel.
When Mabel dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Mabel enters, it triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Repeat.

1453-4694-6495-7306.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature with a +1/+1 counter on it.
1453-4694-6495-7306.description:
Activate Evereth by sacrificing a creature with a +1/+1 counter on it.
When that creature dies, The Ooze triggers, creating a Mutagen artifact token for each +1/+1 counter on the sacrificed creature. These artifacts are also 0/0 creatures due to March of the Machines.
Each Mutagen artifact creature token enters with at least one +1/+1 counter on it due to Arwen.
Resolve the Evereth ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on them.
Repeat from step 1.
1453-4694-6495-7306.notes: If you have a way to kill Evereth and {1}{B/R} available, you can do so after putting a significant amount of +1/+1 counters on it to deal damage to each opponent using its second ability.

333-3899-5617.notablePrerequisites: Fungal Fortitude attached to Shepherd of the Cosmos.
333-3899-5617.description:
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing Shepherd of the Cosmos.
When Shepherd of the Cosmos dies, Fungal Fortitude triggers, returning Shepherd of the Cosmos from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Shepherd of the Cosmos enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Fungal Fortitude from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Shepherd of the Cosmos.
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

4247-6972-7233.easyPrerequisites: Instant and sorcery cards in your graveyard have total mana value X or greater.
4247-6972-7233.description:
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing Inferno Project.
When Inferno Project dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the Bloodthrone Vampire ability.
Repeat.

1429-4981-5330.description:
Activate Atog by sacrificing Lesser Masticore
When Lesser Masticore dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Lesser Masticore enters, Serra Redeemer triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Lesser Masticore
Resolve the Atog ability.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more loyalty counters on it

2557-4094-5478-6441-7942.description:
Activate Kaya's second loyalty ability by removing two loyalty counters from it, causing you to double any tokens you create this turn.
Activate Saurian Explorer by paying {6}, creating eight untapped New Planet tokens due to the three token doublers and Spelunking.
Activate six of the tokens by tapping them, adding {6}.
Repeat from step 2
2557-4094-5478-6441-7942.notes: An infinite card draw result has been added to this combo due to Cultivator Colossus or a similar card. This likely limits the other results based on the number of cards in your library.

3263-5256-6871--183.manaNeeded: {0} plus the cost of the creature that earthbends
3263-5256-6871--183.description:
Cast the earthbending creature by paying its mana cost, causing it to enter as an artifact land creature due to Mycosynth Lattice and Toph.
When that creature enters, it earthbends, causing itself to become a land creature with haste, putting at least one +1/+1 counter on itself, and creating a delayed triggered ability.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing that creature.
When that creature dies, the delayed ability from step 2 triggers, causing it to return to the battlefield tapped as an artifact land creature.
Repeat from step 2 any number of times.
Resolve all activated abilities from Altar of Dementia.

1895-2781-3375-6867.description:
Cast Appa either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {W}{W} plus commander tax, if applicable.
When Appa enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Felidar Guardian with the ability to cast it later from exile.
Cast Felidar Guardian from exile by paying {0}.
Appa's second ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Ally creature token
When Felidar Guardian enters, it triggers, blinking Appa.
Repeat from step 2.

1744-6567-7752.description:
Cast Rite of Replication with kicker by paying {7}{U}{U}, creating five token copies of Dragonhawk.
When the Dragonhawk tokens enter the battlefield, they each trigger.
Resolve the first trigger, exiling a number of cards from the top of your library with the ability to play them until your next end step.
Repeat step 3 for each remaining trigger.
At the beginning of your end step, each Dragonhawk token triggers, dealing 2 damage to each opponent for each card exiled by the Dragonhawk tokens that were not played.
1744-6567-7752.notes: Assuming you control no other creatures with power 4 or greater, this combo can deal up to 60 damage to each opponent. This is reduced by 2 for each card you play that is exiled. For every additional creature you control with power 4 or greater, this combo deals up to an additional 10 damage per creature to each opponent.

uses.n: Aang, Swift Savior // Aang and La, Ocean's Fury

6867-7043-7444.description:
Cast Appa by paying {W}{W}.
When Appa enters, it triggers, airbending Aang, Swift Savior // Aang and La, Ocean's Fury.
Cast Aang, Swift Savior // Aang and La, Ocean's Fury from exile by paying {0}.
Appa triggers, creating a 1/1 Ally creature token.
When Aang, Swift Savior // Aang and La, Ocean's Fury enters, it triggers, airbending Appa.
Cast Appa from exile by paying {0}.
Repeat from step 2.

1978-2593-7290.description:
Animate Astral Cornucopia using Does Machines.
Activate Astral Cornucopia by tapping it, adding at least three mana of any color.
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Astral Cornucopia.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with Mirror Room locked and Fractured Realm unlocked

1753-2872-5921-5970.description:
Activate Marina by tapping it, unlocking Mirror Room.
Mirror Room triggers twice due to Fractured Realm, creating two token copies of Clever Conjurer.
Activate one of the Clever Conjurer tokens by tapping it, untapping Marina.
Activate Marina by tapping it, locking Mirror Room.
Activate the other Clever Conjurer token by tapping it, untapping Marina.
Repeat.

643-5147-5310-6879.description:
Cast Bloodghast by paying {B}{B}.
When Bloodghast enters as an Ally due to Maskwood Nexus, Haru triggers, earthbending a land.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Bloodghast.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing a land creature.
When the land creature dies, Haru triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When the land enters, Bloodghast triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Bloodghast enters as an Ally due to Maskwood Nexus, Haru triggers, earthbending a land.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability from step 4.
Repeat from step 3.
643-5147-5310-6879.notes: If the chosen land can enter untapped and produce mana, you may do so each iteration to get infinite mana of those color(s) and type(s).

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more charge counters on it

539-2734-3899-4552-6705.description:
Animate Spawning Pit using Cyberdrive Awakener.
Activate Spawning Pit's second ability by removing two charge counters from it, creating two creature tokens.
Activate Spawning Pit's first ability twice by sacrificing the creature tokens, putting two charge counters on it.
Repeat from step 2.

3532-3949-5078-5705.easyPrerequisites: There is a removable counter on a creature you control.
3532-3949-5078-5705.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
When Sensei's Divining Top enters, Kappa Cannoneer triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Kappa Cannoneer.
Repeat.

339-677-3499-5686.description:
Activate Jegantha by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} that cannot be spent to pay generic mana costs.
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Jegantha.
Activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, causing you to cast Jegantha from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

4593-4659-5870-6291.description:
Activate Mite Overseer by paying {3}{W/P}, creating a 1/1 Thopter and a 1/1 Phyrexian Mite artifact creature token.
When the Phyrexian Mite and Thopter enter, Guide of Souls triggers twice, causing you to gain 2 life and get {E}{E}
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks twice by sacrificing the Phyrexian Mite and Thopter, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Repeat.
4593-4659-5870-6291.notes: Once you have infinite mana, you may forego sacrificing the Phyrexian Mite and/or Thopter

222-527-4927-5147.easyPrerequisites:
You control a Saproling.
You control a creature with power 5 or greater.
222-527-4927-5147.description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {1}{B}{R}{G}{G}.
Activate Goblin Bombardment twice by sacrificing Selvala and Slimefoot and Squee.
Activate Slimefoot and Squee by paying {1}{B}{R}{G} and sacrificing a Saproling, returning it and Selvala from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Slimefoot and Squee enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Repeat.

1537-3817-3967-6542.description:
Activate Sidisi by tapping it and sacrificing Zealous Conscripts, returning Sister Hospitaller from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Sister Hospitaller enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Zealous Conscripts from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to gain 5 life.
When Zealous Conscripts enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping Sidisi.
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Sister Hospitaller.
Repeat.

38-301-345.notablePrerequisites: Putrid Goblin does not have a -1/-1 counter on it.
38-301-345.description:
Activate Skirk Prospector by sacrificing Putrid Goblin, adding {R}.
When Putrid Goblin dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to Metallic Mimic.
Repeat.

3143-4613-4762-5641.easyPrerequisites:
Devoted Druid exiled by Agatha's Soul Cauldron.
You control at least one additional creature.
3143-4613-4762-5641.description:
Activate Xavier Sal's second ability by tapping it and sacrificing another creature, putting a +1/+1 counter on it and Basking Broodscale.
Basking Broodscale triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Xavier Sal using Devoted Druid's second ability by putting a -1/-1 counter on it, untapping Xavier Sal.
Repeat.

1846-5478-5702-5954.easyPrerequisites: Springheart Nantuko attached to Overlord of the Hauntwoods.
1846-5478-5702-5954.notablePrerequisites: Overlord of the Hauntwoods does not have summoning sickness.
1846-5478-5702-5954.description:
Cast High Tide by paying {U}.
Declare Overlord of the Hauntwoods as an attacker.
Overlord of the Hauntwoods triggers, creating an untapped Everywhere land token due to Spelunking.
When the Everywhere token enters the battlefield, Springheart Nantuko triggers.
Holding priority, activate Everywhere by tapping it, adding {G}.
High Tide triggers, adding {U}.
Resolve the Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Overlord of the Hauntwoods.
When the Overlord of the Hauntwoods token enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a tapped Everywhere land token.
Repeat from step 4.

3284-4550-4871-5231.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
3284-4550-4871-5231.description:
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing another creature, adding {R}.
Korvold's second ability and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Korvold trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on it and causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding one mana of any color.
Korvold's second ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it and causing you to draw a card.
Activate Zombie Infestation by discarding two cards, creating a 2/2 Zombie creature token.
Repeat.

1492-2478-5660-5943.notablePrerequisites:
There is at least one additional artifact on the battlefield.
One of the self-sacrificing artifacts must be in your hand, with the other in your graveyard.
1492-2478-5660-5943.description:
Cast the self-sacrificing artifact in your hand by paying {0}.
Ms. Bumbleflower triggers, causing an opponent to draw a card, and then putting a +1/+1 counter on Evolution Witness.
Evolution Witness triggers, returning the self-sacrificing artifact from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate the self-sacrificing artifact cast in step 1 by sacrificing it, and paying other costs if necessary.
Repeat.

204-2100-5851.manaNeeded: {12} at most, depending on how many Stormsplitters and/or other creatures you control without summoning sickness
204-2100-5851.notablePrerequisites: Sorcerer Class is at least level 2.
204-2100-5851.description:
Activate any creature you control that does not have summoning sickness by tapping it, adding {R} that can only be spent to cast an instant or sorcery spell, or to gain a Class level.
Repeat step 1 until you control no untapped creatures without summoning sickness, or until you have {4}{R} available, whichever comes first.
Cast Searing Touch with buyback by paying {4}{R}.
Each Stormsplitter you control triggers, and Sorcerer Class's third ability triggers if it is level 3.
Resolve the Stormsplitter triggers, creating that many token copies of Stormsplitter.
Resolve the Sorcerer Class trigger, if applicable, dealing damage to any target equal to the number of instant and/or sorcery spells you've cast this turn.
Resolve Searing Touch, dealing 1 damage to any target, and returning Searing Touch to your hand.
Repeat.

457-1469-5491.description:
At the beginning of your upkeep, Court of Vantress triggers, creating a token copy of Worldwalker Helm plus a Map token.
Activate Urza's first ability twice by tapping a Worldwaker Helm and a Map, adding {U}{U}.
Activate a Worldwalker Helm by paying {1}{U} and tapping it, creating a token copy of the Worldwalker Helm token plus a Map token for each Worldwalker Helm you control.
Activate Urza's first ability twice by tapping two Maps, adding {U}{U}.
Repeat from step 3.
457-1469-5491.notes: Once you have infinite mana, you may use it to activate Urza's ability.

1506-4067-5806.notablePrerequisites:
Thieving Otter does not have summoning sickness.
Burning Anger attached to Thieving Otter.
1506-4067-5806.description:
Activate Thieving Otter by tapping it, dealing 2 damage to an opponent.
Thieving Otter triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Activate Mind Over Matter by discarding a card, untapping Thieving Otter.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Ghyrson Starn.

428-2770-5096-5361.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to deal exactly 2 damage to an opponent.
428-2770-5096-5361.description:
Cast Donate by paying its mana cost, giving an opponent control of Protection of the Hekma.
Deal 2 damage to that opponent by any method, reduced to 1 due to Protection of the Hekma.
Ghyrson Starn and Auton Soldier trigger.
Resolve the Ghyrson Starn trigger, dealing 1 damage to the opponent.
Auton Soldier triggers, dealing 1 damage to the opponent.
Ghyrson Starn triggers, dealing 1 damage to the opponent.
Repeat from step 5.

277-1409-2895-3756.manaNeeded: {1}{G}{U} plus enough mana to pay for commander tax, if applicable
277-1409-2895-3756.description:
Cast Uro by paying {1}{G}{U}
When Uro enters the battlefield, its first and second abilities trigger, as well as Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability.
Resolve the Deadeye Navigator trigger, pairing it and Uro.
Resolve the second Uro trigger, causing you to draw a card, gain 3 life, and put Izzet Boilerworks from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Izzet Boilerworks enters, it and Tiller Engine trigger.
Resolve the Tiller Engine trigger, untapping Izzet Boilerworks.
Holding priority, activate Izzet Boilerworks by tapping it, adding {U}{R}.
Resolve the Izzet Boilerworks trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Activate Uro by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
Repeat from step 2.

710-2386-2579-5256.notablePrerequisites: Pattern of Rebirth attached to Danitha.
710-2386-2579-5256.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Danitha.
When Danitha dies, The Cauldron of Eternity and Pattern of Rebirth trigger.
Resolve the Cauldron of Eternity trigger, putting Danitha on the bottom of your library from your graveyard.
Resolve the Pattern of Rebirth trigger, putting Danitha from your library onto the battlefield.
When Danitha enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Pattern of Rebirth from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Danitha.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability from step 1, causing target player to mill cards equal to Danitha's power.
Repeat.

360-618-3957-4613.notablePrerequisites: Famished Paladin has at least one +1/+1 counter on it and does not have summoning sickness.
360-618-3957-4613.description:
Activate Famished Paladin using Kiki-Jiki's ability by tapping it, creating a token copy of itself with haste.
When the Famished Paladin token enters the battlefield, Soul Warden triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Each Famished Paladin you control triggers, untapping themselves.
Repeat.
You may also target any nonlegendary creature you control.

262-2534-4875.notablePrerequisites:
Elemental Mastery attached to Coercive Recruiter.
Coercive Recruiter does not have summoning sickness.
"Pirate" chosen with Conspiracy.
262-2534-4875.description:
Activate Coercive Recruiter by tapping it, creating at least four 1/1 Elemental creature tokens with haste.
When the Elementals enter the battlefield as Pirates due to Conspiracy, Coercive Recruiter triggers four times.
Resolve the first three triggers, causing you to gain control of up to three other creatures and untap them.
Resolve the last trigger, untapping Coercive Recruiter.
Repeat.
You may also repeat this during each of your turns to gain control of all creatures during your turn.

uses.n: Etali, Primal Conqueror // Etali, Primal Sickness

2178-4147-4294-5291.notablePrerequisites:
Hua Tuo does not have summoning sickness.
Thornbite Staff attached to Hua Tuo.Primal Conquerer.
It is your precombat main phase.
2178-4147-4294-5291.description:
Cast Cursed Mirror by paying {2}{R}, choosing to have it enter the battlefield as a copy of Etali.
Choose to put Etali into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
If Etali is your commander, choose not to return it to the command zone from your graveyard.
Cursed Mirror and Hua Tuo trigger.
Resolve the Hua Tuo trigger untapping it.
Activate Hua Tuo by tapping it, putting Etali on top of your library from your graveyard.
Resolve the Cursed Mirror trigger from step 4, causing you to exile cards from each player's library until you exile a nonland card, with you exiling Etali from your library, and cast Etali and any other nonland cards exiled this way without paying their mana costs.
Choose to put Etali into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
If Etali is your commander, choose not to return it to the command zone from your graveyard.
Etali and Hua Tuo trigger.
Resolve the Hua Tuo trigger untapping it.
Activate Hua Tuo by tapping it, putting Etali on top of your library from your graveyard.
Resolve the Etali trigger from step 10, causing you to exile cards from each player's library until you exile a nonland card, with you exiling Etali from your library, and cast Etali and any other nonland cards exiled this way without paying their mana costs.
Repeat from step 8.

1981-4050-4378.description:
Sacrifice a creature to Phyrexian Altar, adding one mana of any color.
Sanguinary Priest triggers, dealing 1 damage to you and gaining 1 life.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier token.
Repeat.

3944-4616-5220.description:
Activate Blood Pet by sacrificing itself, adding {B}.
Blood Pet dies, triggering Moldervine Reclamation and Mortuary.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Blood Pet on top of your library from your graveyard.
Resolve the Moldervine Reclamation trigger, causing you to draw Blood Pet and gain 1 life.
Cast Blood Pet by paying {B}.
Repeat.

1339-1636-4971.notablePrerequisites: Niv-Mizzet does not have summoning sickness.
1339-1636-4971.description:
Activate Niv-Mizzet by tapping it, causing you to draw a card.
The Locust God and Niv-Mizzet triggers.
Resolve the Niv-Mizzet trigger, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Resolve the Locust God trigger, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token with flying and haste.
The Insect enters the battlefield, triggering Intruder Alarm, untapping all creatures.
Repeat.

uses.exileCardState: with a kick counter on it

249-3094-4091-5107.notablePrerequisites:
Zethi and Aphetto Alchemist do not have summoning sickness.
Creatures you control can tap to produce at least {4}{W}.
249-3094-4091-5107.description:
Declare Zethi as an attacker, triggering its second ability.
Holding priority, activate all mana producing creatures you control by tapping them, adding at least {4}{W}.
Activate Lithoform Engine's first ability by paying {2} and tapping it, copying Zethi's triggered ability.
Resolve the copy of Zethi's ability, creating a copy of each card exiled with a kick counter of it and causing you to pay {1}{W} to cast the copy of Rally of Wings.
Resolve the Rally of Wings copy, untapping all creatures you control.
Activate Aphetto Alchemist by tapping it, untapping Lithoform Engine.
Repeat from step 2.
Once you have infinite mana, you may use that mana to then cast the copies of all other cards exiled with kick counters on them.

225-539-1671-3177.description:
Activate Sakura-Tribe Scout by tapping it, putting Simic Growth Chamber from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Simic Growth Chamber enters, it and Stone-Seeder Hierophant trigger.
Resolve the Simic Growth Chamber trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Stone-Seeder Hierophant trigger, untapping it.
Activate Stone-Seeder Hierophant by tapping it, untapping Sakura-Tribe Scout as it is a land due to Ashaya.
Repeat.
